description: A switched admittance with discrete steps, most often used in power flow studies. Total admittance is number_engaged * Y_increase, unless solved_admittance is set, in which case that value is the effective admittance.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Unique among components of the same type; components of different types may share a name.

available.description: Whether the component is online (true) or offline (false). Unavailable components are excluded from simulations.

bus.description: ID of the bus that this component is connected to.

admittance_units.description: Unit basis for the shunt admittance fields. COMPONENT_MVAR is PSS/E RAW native (Mvar/MW at unity voltage).

number_engaged.description: Number of steps currently engaged (switched in) for each adjustable shunt block; cannot exceed number_of_steps for that block.

number_of_steps.description: Number of available steps for admittance increment at each adjustable shunt block.

Y_increase.description: Admittance increment for each adjustable shunt block, e.g. Y_increase[2] is the increment at block 2. Units: per admittance_units — NATURAL_UNITS: S, COMPONENT_MVAR: MVAr .

solved_admittance.description: Solved-case switched shunt admittance (PSS/E BINIT); when present it is the shunt's effective admittance, used in place of `number_engaged` * `Y_increase`. Units: per admittance_units — NATURAL_UNITS: S, COMPONENT_MVAR: MVAr .

admittance_limits.description: Shunt admittance limits for switched shunt model. Units: per admittance_units — NATURAL_UNITS: S, COMPONENT_MVAR: MVAr .

regulated_bus_number.description: Bus number whose voltage/quantity this shunt regulates; 0 means local bus (PSS/E SWREM/NREG). Units: 1.

dynamic_injector.description: ID of the corresponding dynamic injection model for admittance, if any.

title: SwitchedAdmittance
